lines.en: : Because Maki isn’t Maki without that quality. It’s a big part of her life and if there’s something {i}you{/i} can do to help her, shouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 因为没有那一点,Maki 就不是 Maki。那是她生命里很大的一部分,如果有什么{i}你{/i}能帮她的,你不该帮吗?

lines.en: : She worked {i}extremely{/i} hard to keep you stable when your dad died. And now that she’s struggling, wouldn’t it be good for {i}both{/i} of you if you were to lend her a hand as well?
lines.zh: : 你爸去世的时候,她{i}拼命{/i}努力才让你稳住。而现在她正在挣扎,要是你也伸出手拉她一把,对你们{i}两个{/i}不都好吗?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain18
: Where is...all this coming from? Why do you sound so responsible and logical all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 这些……都是从哪来的?你怎么突然听起来这么有责任心、这么讲道理?

lines.en: : I don’t know, but I hate it. And I wish I could go back to not caring about anything, but I’m starting to realize that might not be possible at this point no matter how much I tell myself it is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,但我讨厌这样。我真希望自己能回到什么都不在乎的状态,可我开始意识到,不管我怎么对自己说可以,这可能都已经做不到了。

lines.en: : There’s no need to go back, Sensei. I think it’s good that you’re changing. But, from my perspective, my whole entire {i}world{/i} has changed in less than a year. So this is all still a little shocking to me.
lines.zh: : 没必要回去,Sensei。我觉得你在改变是好事。不过从我这边看,我的整个{i}世界{/i}在不到一年里就全变了。所以这一切对我来说还是有点冲击。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain19
: So...to recap, in true Makoto fashion...
lines.zh: : 那么……用真正的 Makoto 方式来总结一下……

lines.en: : My mom thinks I’m having sex. And, as a result of that, she no longer {i}wants{/i} to have sex.
lines.zh: : 我妈觉得我在做爱。结果就是,她自己不{i}想{/i}做爱了。

lines.en: : Additionally, I can {i}not{/i} frivolously fuck you whenever I want as the mechanics of these “resets” will not automatically renew any relationship I destroy once a new cycle begins.
lines.zh: : 另外,我不能随心所欲地随时操你,因为这些『重置』的机制{i}不会{/i}在新一轮循环开始时自动修复任何被我毁掉的关系。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain20
: And also, more importantly than any of that...you love me.
lines.zh: : 还有,比这些都更重要的是……你爱我。

lines.en: : So you’ll talk to your mom?
lines.zh: : 所以你会跟你妈谈?

lines.en: : You {i}actually{/i} love me.
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}爱我。

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto-

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do. But I can’t guarantee it will go well.
lines.zh: : 我看看能怎么做。但我不能保证会顺利。

lines.en: : Great. Then {i}now{/i} I will scold you.
lines.zh: : 很好。那么{i}现在{/i}我要训你了。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain21
: What?! Why?! I’ve been completely obedient so far!
lines.zh: : 什么?!为什么?!我到现在一直都很听话啊!

lines.en: : Because you talked to Ami about something you weren’t supposed to talk to her about.
lines.zh: : 因为你跟 Ami 说了不该跟她说的事。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain22
: Ugh. If this is about what I think it’s about, I already got an earful from Maya and I doubt you have anything to add that she didn’t already cover.
lines.zh: : 呃。如果这是我想的那件事,我已经被 Maya 念过一通了,我怀疑你还能说出她没说过的东西。

lines.en: : She must have sent me over like fifty messages about this. But I had no idea I was even supposed to {i}keep{/i} it from Ami. If it was that big of a deal, somebody should have warned me.
lines.zh: : 她大概为这事给我发了五十条消息。可我根本不知道这事还得{i}瞒{/i}着 Ami。要是这么要紧,总该有人警告我一声吧。

lines.en: : Well, if she already talked to you about it, there’s no sense in me doing it as well. Especially since I still don’t really understand the reasoning behind it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,既然她已经跟你说过了,我也没必要再说一遍。尤其是我自己到现在也还是不太理解其中的缘由。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain23
: I may very well be wrong here, but I’m not sure Maya does either.
lines.zh: : 我说错也说不定,但我不确定 Maya 自己就懂。

lines.en: : Or, in the case that she {i}does{/i} know, she might be withholding information from me as I have learned {i}all about{/i} what {i}not{/i} to talk to Ami about, but I still don’t understand {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 或者,就算她{i}真的{/i}知道,她可能在对我隐瞒信息——因为我学了{i}那么多{/i}『{i}不{/i}该跟 Ami 谈什么』,却依然不明白{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: : It was just a lot of “Trust me” and “Things need to be like this or the world will break.”
lines.zh: : 无非就是一堆『相信我』和『事情必须这样,否则世界会崩坏』。

lines.en: : She can be...a little controlling at times, yeah.
lines.zh: : 她有时候……是有点控制欲,嗯。

lines.en: : But I do think she has our best interest at heart.
lines.zh: : 但我确实认为她是为我们好。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain24
: I guess I’ll just defer to you, then.
lines.zh: : 那我就听你的吧。

lines.en: : Thanks, Makoto. All things considered, I think this went pretty well.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Makoto。总的来说,我觉得这次谈得挺好。

lines.en: : Me too. It was nice being able to directly {i}talk{/i} about something for once without everything going to shit.
lines.zh: : 我也是。能有一次直接{i}谈{/i}点什么、而一切没变得更糟,感觉真好。

lines.en: : We’ve been getting good at that lately. It happened on the roof as well.
lines.zh: : 我们最近越来越擅长这个了。在屋顶上那次也是。

lines.en: : Some might even say that all of these talks are {i}better{/i} than sex.
lines.zh: : 有些人甚至会说,这些谈话比做爱{i}还好{/i}。

lines.en: : They’re nice. But I don’t think I’m anywhere near that level yet.
lines.zh: : 是不错。但我觉得自己离那个境界还差得远。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain25
: Good, because neither am I and I am about to ride your dick so hard that it might snap off.
lines.zh: : 很好,因为我也没到,而且我马上就要骑你的鸡巴骑到它断掉。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain26
{b}________MEANWHILE{/b}
lines.zh: {b}________MEANWHILE{/b}

lines.en: : Hey, Maya. Whatcha doing?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Maya。在干嘛呢?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain27
: Hm?
scene makotoinnagain28
: Oh...Ami. I didn’t hear you sneak up.
lines.zh: : 哦……Ami。我没听见你悄悄凑过来。

lines.en: : I’m just killing time until lunch.
lines.zh: : 我只是在打发时间,等吃午饭。

lines.en: : Are you not doing the hug thingy with Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你没在跟 Noriko 搞那个拥抱的事?

lines.en: : We’ve...established a temporary truce as Sensei managed to escape in the chaos of the first battle.
lines.zh: : 我们……达成了临时休战,因为 Sensei 趁第一战的混乱逃走了。

lines.en: : Many lives were lost, but all will be remembered...
lines.zh: : 许多生命消逝了,但都会被铭记……

lines.en: : Gone but not forgotten...
lines.zh: : 人虽已逝,精神长存……

lines.en: : Can I sit?
lines.zh: : 我能坐下吗?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain26
: Do as you please. I don’t own the beach.
lines.zh: : 随你的便。这片海滩又不是我的。

lines.en: : But do you {i}want{/i} me to sit?
lines.zh: : 可你{i}想{/i}让我坐吗?

lines.en: : Does what I want actually matter to you?
lines.zh: : 我想要什么,对你来说真的重要吗?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain29
: Of course! I’m not the one who started this, you know?
lines.zh: : 当然!先挑起这事的人又不是我,你知道吧?

lines.en: : You’re {i}still{/i} sticking to that story?
lines.zh: : 你{i}还{/i}在坚持那套说法?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain30
: Maya, I don’t know {i}why{/i} you led me to the middle of nowhere. Or why you’re suddenly trying to avoid me and...a whole bunch of stuff like this. But I want it to stop.
lines.zh: : Maya,我不知道你{i}为什么{/i}把我带到那种荒无人烟的地方。也不知道你为什么突然开始躲着我……还有一大堆这样的事。但我想让这一切停下来。

lines.en: : I miss you. Ayane too.
lines.zh: : 我想你。也想 Ayane。

lines.en: : And up until recently, we were together almost every single day. But now, it seems like there’s a whole bunch of other stuff you care about more than me.
lines.zh: : 直到不久前,我们几乎每天都在一起。可现在,你似乎有一大堆别的事比我还重要。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain31
: If I, like...annoy you or something...just tell me. Ghosting me and picking on me and stuff just makes it hurt more.
lines.zh: : 如果我……嗯……让你烦了什么的……就直接告诉我。对我玩消失、挑我毛病什么的,只会让我更难受。

lines.en: : I’m doing no such thing, Ami. And I miss you too.
lines.zh: : 我可没干那种事,Ami。我也想你。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain32
: Do you really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗?……

lines.en: : Of course. What would I have to gain from lying about that?
lines.zh: : 当然。我撒这种谎有什么好处?

lines.en: : Nothing, I...I just don’t get why you’ve been so distant, then. If something is happening, you can talk to me about it. I’ll listen. That’s what friends are for, right?
lines.zh: : 没有,我只是……只是不明白你为什么变得这么疏远。如果发生了什么事,你可以跟我说。我会听的。朋友不就是干这个的吗?

lines.en: : As much as I love you, there are certain things I just can’t talk to you about. And I’m sure it’s the same for you.
lines.zh: : 我有多爱你,就有多少事是我不能跟你说的。我相信你也一样。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain33
: What if it didn’t have to be like that, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果不必非得那样呢?

lines.en: : What if we threw away all of our secrets and just moved forward together? Like the way things were when you first showed up?
lines.zh: : 如果我们抛开所有秘密,就这么一起往前走呢?就像你刚出现时的那种样子。

lines.en: : We got attached so quickly....It was almost like we knew each other already or something.
lines.zh: : 我们那么快就变得亲密……几乎像是早就认识了一样。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you think we’ll ever...get back to something like that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们还能……回到那样的状态吗?

lines.en: : I can’t predict the future, but...
lines.zh: : 我无法预测未来,不过……

lines.en: : It would be nice if we could.
lines.zh: : 如果能的话,会很好。

lines.en: : Growing up sure is painful, huh?...
lines.zh: : 长大真痛苦啊,对吧?……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain34
: You and me both. I keep telling myself every morning, “This is your year, Ami.” But they’re the same exact size they’ve always been.
lines.zh: : 我也是。每天早上我都对自己说:『这是你的一年,Ami。』可它们还是跟以前一模一样的尺寸。

lines.en: : At least you’ve got {i}something.{/i} Even Sana’s bigger than me and that’s just downright sad.
lines.zh: : 至少你还有点{i}东西{/i}。连 Sana 都比我大,这也太惨了。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain35
: Wanna compare? You rub mine and I rub yours? I heard it helps them grow.
lines.zh: : 要比比看吗?你揉我的,我揉你的?我听说这样能帮助发育。

lines.en: : Please keep your hands off of me.
lines.zh: : 请你把手拿开。

lines.en: : How come? Saving your body for somebody else?
lines.zh: : 为什么?这副身子是要留给别人的?

lines.en: : As if anyone deserves this body. I’m content keeping it to myself.
lines.zh: : 好像有人配得上这副身子似的。我自己留着就好。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain36
: {i}There’s{/i} the Maya I know. Just as conceited as ever. I wish {i}I{/i} had that sort of confidence.
lines.zh: : {i}这才是{/i}我认识的 Maya。还是一如既往地自大。我真希望{i}自己{/i}也有那种自信。

lines.en: : You’re the only one who can compete, Ami. I don’t know anyone else who’s even half as cute as you.
lines.zh: : 你是唯一能跟我比的,Ami。我还没见过有谁的可爱有你一半。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain37
: Aww...
lines.zh: : 哇哦……

lines.en: : You really mean it?
lines.zh: : 你说真的?

lines.en: : Of course. What would I have to gain from lying about that?
lines.zh: : 当然。我撒这种谎有什么好处?

lines.en: : You used that same line just a minute ago, you know.
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前刚用过同样的说辞哦。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain38
: Did not.
lines.zh: : 才没有。

lines.en: : Did too.
lines.zh: : 就有。

lines.en: : Nope. Didn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 没有。没说过。

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain39
: It totally did happen...and you know it.
lines.zh: : 明明就有过……你心里清楚。

lines.en: : You’re really going to lie to your best friend?
lines.zh: : 你真要对你最好的朋友撒谎?

lines.en: : That’s...
: That wasn’t...
lines.zh: : 那不是……

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain40
: Shh...
: Friends don’t lie to each other...okay?
lines.zh: : 朋友之间是不会互相撒谎的……好吗?

lines.en: scene makotoinnagain41
: Great! Let’s {i}both{/i} try to be better friends from now on, then!
lines.zh: : 太好了!那从现在起我们{i}都{/i}努力当更好的朋友吧!

lines.en: : Also, are you using a new shampoo? You smell really nice. Your skin is super soft too. What is it? Can I borrow some?
lines.zh: : 还有,你是不是换了洗发水?你闻起来好香。皮肤也超级滑。是什么?能借我用用吗?

lines.en: : I can...show you?
lines.zh: : 我可以……给你看?

lines.en: : Really? Is now okay? Because I’m totally free up until tonight’s contests and I could really go for a nice bath right now.
lines.zh: : 真的?现在可以吗?因为今晚的比赛之前我完全有空,而且我现在特别想泡个舒服的澡。

lines.en: : We can call it a...friendship rejuvenation bath! Or something! Since we’re friends again and we’re not going to hurt each other anymore. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 我们可以管它叫……友谊复兴浴!之类的!既然我们又做回朋友了,而且再也不会互相伤害了。对吧,Maya?

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : Hurting you is the {i}last{/i} thing I’d ever want to do...
lines.zh: : 伤害你是我{i}最不愿意{/i}做的事……

lines.en: scene black
: Then don’t mind if I hold you to that! Heheh!
lines.zh: : 那我就当你说到做到啦!嘿嘿!
